# chargebee_item_price (Resource)

A Chargebee item price (Product Catalog 2.0): the price of an item in one currency and billing period. Set item_id, name, currency_code, and pricing_model together to create a new price. Omit all four to adopt an existing price by id and track it as-is (every field is read from Chargebee); this is the way to bring an archived price under management with just `id` and `status = "archived"`. If an item price with the given id already exists when creating, it is adopted into state and its mutable fields are updated to match this configuration; adoption fails if a create-only field (item_id, currency_code) differs from the existing price. If deletion is refused because the price is in use, it is archived instead (the id stays reserved in Chargebee).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "chargebee_item_price" "standard_eur" {
  id            = "standard-eur"
  item_id       = chargebee_item.standard.id
  name          = "standard-eur"
  currency_code = "EUR"
  pricing_model = "per_unit"
  price         = 4900 # cents
  period        = 1
  period_unit   = "month"
}

resource "chargebee_item_price" "api_calls_eur" {
  id            = "api-calls-eur"
  item_id       = chargebee_item.api_calls.id
  name          = "api-calls-eur"
  currency_code = "EUR"
  pricing_model = "tiered"
  period        = 1
  period_unit   = "month"

  tiers = [
    { starting_unit = 1, ending_unit = 100000, price = 0 },
    { starting_unit = 100001, price = 1 },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the item price. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `billing_cycles` (Number) Number of billing cycles after which the subscription item expires. Omit for indefinite billing.
- `currency_code` (String) ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. `EUR`). Read from Chargebee when omitted; must be set together with `item_id`, `name`, and `pricing_model` to create a new price. Changing this forces a new resource: a price in a different currency is a different price point.
- `description` (String) Description of the item price.
- `external_name` (String) Customer-facing name shown on invoices and checkout (Chargebee defaults it to the price name).
- `free_quantity` (Number) Quantity included for free (Chargebee defaults to 0).
- `invoice_notes` (String) Notes added to invoices for this price.
- `is_taxable` (Boolean) Whether the price is taxable (Chargebee defaults to true).
- `item_id` (String) Id of the item this price belongs to. Read from Chargebee when omitted; must be set together with `name`, `currency_code`, and `pricing_model` to create a new price. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Display name of the item price (unique across the site). Read from Chargebee when omitted; must be set together with `item_id`, `currency_code`, and `pricing_model` to create a new price.
- `period` (Number) Length of the billing period. Set together with `period_unit` for recurring prices; omit both for one-time charges.
- `period_unit` (String) Unit of the billing period: `day`, `week`, `month`, or `year`.
- `price` (Number) Price in the currency's smallest unit (e.g. cents). Required for `flat_fee` and `per_unit`; not valid for tier-based models.
- `pricing_model` (String) Pricing model: `flat_fee`, `per_unit`, `tiered`, `volume`, or `stairstep`. Read from Chargebee when omitted; must be set together with `item_id`, `name`, and `currency_code` to create a new price.
- `show_description_in_invoices` (Boolean) Whether the description is shown on invoices.
- `show_description_in_quotes` (Boolean) Whether the description is shown on quotes.
- `status` (String) Status of the item price in Chargebee: `active` or `archived`. Defaults to the price's current status in Chargebee; set `archived` to archive the price under Terraform management.
- `tiers` (Attributes List) Quantity tiers for the `tiered`, `volume`, and `stairstep` pricing models, in ascending order of `starting_unit`. Omit `ending_unit` on the last tier for an unbounded tier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers))
- `trial_period` (Number) Length of the free trial. Set together with `trial_period_unit`.
- `trial_period_unit` (String) Unit of the trial period: `day` or `month`.

<a id="nestedatt--tiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tiers`

Required:

- `price` (Number) Price for this tier in the currency's smallest unit.
- `starting_unit` (Number) First unit covered by this tier.

Optional:

- `ending_unit` (Number) Last unit covered by this tier; omit for an unbounded final tier.
